posts.cooked:
So we have a Variant heavy week this week

Vanilla Baron Blade vs Visionary Unleashed, Setting Sun Ra, EXTREEEEEEME Haka, EXTREEEEEEME Fanatic, EXTREEEEEEME Tempest in insula primalis. 

Was a very fun fight. There are some probably horrible misplays I made but making it so the Barron had to play the same card 3 times was fun. Also skipping Haka's turn whilst ground point and the volcanic eruption was out was a great bit of amusement to me. 

Mint with everyone in low 20's high teens.

posts.name: Gus_Smedstad
posts.cooked:
Really easy mint. I guess they heard that I screwed up the easy Voss in Egypt challenge, so they lowered the difficulty another notch.

Didn’t do anything clever, didn’t use Into the Stratosphere even once.

Visionary put Twist the Aether on Ra since he was consistently doing damage, though in retrospect it would have been smarter to put it on Visionary herself, since this variant does damage pretty much every turn. Normally I treat Twist the Aether as a defensive card, but doing damage to Blade on his front side is a much higher priority than blunting his occasional attacks.

I left the Obsidian Field up for a long time just because of the damage race on Blade’s front side.

I used Wrest the Mind in the canonical fashion - on the second Blade Battalion to come out, so it was doing 6 points of damage a turn to whoever I wanted (+1 damage for Obsidian Field).

I made a point of leaving the Blade Battalions alive while Blade was on his front side, just to avoid the chance of Blade’s discard pile growing, but I flipped him so fast it turned out to be unimportant.

Haka was the only hero to get seriously hurt because he kept stepping in front of damage. At one point he was down to 1 HP. Unusually for Haka, he never did any damage himself, since I drew no damaging cards.

posts.name: Reverend Pete
posts.cooked:
Mint.

 

Played fast and reckless -- damage flying all over the place. Baron Blade bit the dust pretty quick.

 

Saw the Volcano, but Tempest ended the game before it erupted.

 

Visionary 13HP, Ra 16HP, Haka 15HP, Fanatic 3HP, Tempest 17HP. Fanatic was at 3 because she used an Obsidian Field-boosted Divine Sacrifice (hitting Blade all three times, thanks to her base power) and on the next turn, Blade did a Slash and Burn, which hit Fanatic with both instances of damage.

Easy Mint. Volcano Eruption finished Blade off.

Nothing too tricky card play wise and I even made a HUGE misplay that pretty much took Fanatic out of commission for a turn (targeted Fanatic with Divine Sacrifice thinking that I’d used her base power on Blade last turn when I had in fact used it on the Mobile Defense Platform before it was destroyed - therefore, not only could I not redirect any of the damage, all of Fanatic’s damage would have redirected to her, so I couldn’t use her base power either...)

No one in any real danger.

posts.name: MindWanderer
posts.cooked: I went hyper-aggressive and won in round 4, despite drawing very little damage for Haka or Tempest. Twist the Ether went on Fanatic because I knew she was about to do 4 instances of damage in one turn. Tempest actually double-skipped twice: once because he had nothing but Into the Stratospheres and Flash Flood in his hand and once just to let the volcano win. Haka went down in round 3 saving Ra from himself, but everyone else was very healthy, even Fanatic.
